verdict.rationale: The evidence describes no sandbox, test, or staging environment where an agent can work without touching the live Model. Several adjacent features appear but are not sandboxes: what-if scenarios (cfo-ai-docs-6, -14), undoable writes logged in a changelog, a per-tool allow/ask/deny approval policy, and separate per-client workspaces. None of these is credited under the partial-credit boundary rule.
